result.title: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
result.summary: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent's own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step's confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68-0.85, and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ~4.3x more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12, and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM agent 能否用自报的每步置信度预测整段 episode 的最终成败，在 GRPO 下借助同一任务 rollout 组提供的成功标签与 proper scoring rule 校准该置信度，并在 ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop 上以离线与在线 RL 检验 AUROC、校准误差和选择性执行。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以最终结果校准逐步置信度」提供了一条把 episode 级标签回传到单步的训练线索，可能启发 LVR 中 STOP 决策与逐步贡献分配的监督方式，可供核查；但该工作为纯文本 agent、无视觉输入与 latent 推理状态，其可迁移性尚需判断。
